 U1 & U2 --> IAP

 BE --> PLAT

 BE -->|video| GV
 BE --> ADK & MCP
 ADK --> G2

 BE --> DB & FS
 BE --> LOG
 BE -.-> MON & TRC

 GH --> WIF --> CB --> AR
 AR --> BE & FE1 & FE2

div.span: 1. External Data & Agent Integration: Integration with external data sources and agents will depend on the client’s technology ecosystem. This may include assets hosted in GCS, Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems, or other enterprise repositories. The architecture also allows for integration with existing client agents, such as creative briefing or creative evaluation agents, where applicable.

div.style: text-align: justify;

span.style: font-size: medium; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.span: 2. Image Generation Accuracy: The solution is continuously evolving, with ongoing exploration of approaches to improve the accuracy, consistency, and quality of generated images.

div.style: text-align: justify;
div.span: 3. Self-Learning & Distillation: Self-learning and distilled learning capabilities are currently exploratory. The architecture remains open to incorporating approaches such as Agent Gym and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) as the solution matures.
